i_0d644e57cf.label: Personal Hygiene & Uniform
i_0d644e57cf.desc: Staff consistently comply with Dubai Municipality personal hygiene requirements. Fingernails clean and short, hair neat and controlled, no body odor. i_7c462d778a.label: Handwashing Practices
i_7c462d778a.desc: Handwashing is performed consistently, with staff washing their hands immediately upon arriving at the restaurant and at all required moments during service.

i_01efab9dd0.label: Bar Entry Hygiene
i_01efab9dd0.desc: Staff entering the bar area wear the required protective items, including gloves and a hairnet or bandana, ensuring that hair is fully controlled and no risk of contamination is present.

i_80e9036316.label: Stock Rotation (FIFO/FEFO)
i_80e9036316.desc: FIFO and FEFO procedures are consistently applied, with all products arranged and used according to their preparation and expiry dates. Stock is rotated correctly and older items are prioritized.

i_332b0fde01.label: Undercounter Chillers & Freezers
i_332b0fde01.desc: Maintained in good working condition, with door gaskets clean, intact, and free from damage. All units operate within the required temperature range. Temperature logs accurately completed and up to date. Items properly labeled and free from expired products.

i_584b0c0ebc.label: Allergen-Sensitive Guest Handling
i_584b0c0ebc.desc: Staff proactively inquire about any food allergies or dietary restrictions when taking orders. All allergen information is communicated clearly to the kitchen, and staff ensure guests with allergies receive accurate guidance and safe menu recommendations.

i_01f1b51153.label: Greeting & Ushering the Guest
i_01f1b51153.desc: Staff provide a prompt and sincere greeting and courteously usher guests to their seats. Asking about a reservation is not required unless the OIC has informed the team that a reservation is expected.

i_1827e92897.label: QR Menu & Introduction Name
i_1827e92897.desc: Staff present the QR menu, introduce themselves, inform guests of the cashless policy, and assist with scanning. Wi-Fi details are provided upon request. Once the guest accesses the menu, staff introduce the Unlimited Promo and add-ons.

i_ae5c843289.label: Call Button & Call Button Watch
i_ae5c843289.desc: Staff explain the call button to guests and respond promptly when pressed, with the nearest team member attending within one minute. Staff greet the guest politely, provide assistance, reset the notification afterward, and wear the call button watch throughout the shift.

i_c8c63025e4.label: Unlimited Promo Procedure
i_c8c63025e4.desc: If the guest chooses the Unlimited Promo, staff politely direct them to review the terms and conditions on the tent card. Staff explain that the timer is used as a reminder for informing guests about the final round of orders. Guests are informed that the promo is valid for 2 hours.

i_c6bcf3d208.label: Self-Service Station Introduction
i_c6bcf3d208.desc: Staff introduce the self-service station to guests and clearly inform them of its purpose and available items.

i_457befc326.label: Order Slip Presentation
i_457befc326.desc: Staff politely provide the order slip, explain how to mark selections, check for discount vouchers when guests choose a la carte, and assist with any questions while the slip is being filled out.

i_74765d2df1.label: Upselling / Suggestive Selling
i_74765d2df1.desc: Upselling and suggestive-selling techniques are consistently applied, with staff confidently recommending suitable add-ons, upgrades, and refill options. Delivered naturally and appropriately.

i_a36886786d.label: 360-Degree Awareness & Responsiveness
i_a36886786d.desc: Staff demonstrate full 360-degree awareness on the floor, proactively observing surroundings and responding promptly to guests needs. Team members anticipate requirements without waiting to be called.

i_9f34c06533.label: Table Setup Standards
i_9f34c06533.desc: Table setup is completed by staff before any food is served, ensuring that all required items are in place and the dining experience begins with a clean, organized, and fully prepared table setting.

i_03765e744d.label: Food Delivery & Guest Acknowledgment
i_03765e744d.desc: Servers or food runners clearly mention the dish name and highlight any special requests or modifications when serving the order. Staff extend a courteous wish for guests to enjoy their meal.

i_d6393949c7.label: OIC Guest Satisfaction Check
i_d6393949c7.desc: The OIC visits each table to assess guest satisfaction, ensuring that both the food quality and the service experience meet expected standards. Any feedback is acknowledged professionally and addressed promptly.

i_455bd4b354.label: Table Maintenance
i_455bd4b354.desc: Staff consistently maintain tables throughout the dining experience, ensuring they remain clean, organized, and free of unnecessary items. Table upkeep is performed proactively.

i_3232578350.label: Dessert & Coffee Offering
i_3232578350.desc: Staff offer dessert and coffee to the guest.

i_4627944c34.label: Post-Meal Amenities
i_4627944c34.desc: Staff provide toothpicks, an appropriate number of candies, and wet wipes to guests after the meal, ensuring a clean, courteous, and complete end-of-service experience.

i_554d82b48f.label: Membership Card
i_554d82b48f.desc: Staff consistently inquire whether guests are registered for the SB membership card and, when they are not, encourage sign-up while clearly explaining the benefits and value of the program.

i_6602cbd2b2.label: Bill Presentation & Guest Engagement
i_6602cbd2b2.desc: Staff present the bill promptly and professionally, inform guests about Qlub as a payment option, and courteously encourage them to share their experience through a Google review.

i_40903125f1.label: Guest Farewell Standards
i_40903125f1.desc: Staff thank the guests sincerely and offer a warm, genuine invitation to visit again, ensuring the dining experience ends on a positive and memorable note.

i_69ccab0b40.label: Display Presentation

i_96100ac3dc.label: Stock Levels & Replenishment

i_d92be7fcb6.label: Pricing & Labeling Accuracy
